title: Count words with messy spacing
prompt:
Count the **words** in a string: maximal runs of non-space characters separated by one or more spaces. Leading, trailing, and repeated spaces must not create phantom words. Implement `process(String s)` returning the count (0 for empty/all-space).

Example: `"  hello   world  "` → `2`.

tests.name: word count
tests.hint: State machine: count on the transition from space to non-space.
